sections.title: Device session
sections.description: Choose a TCSPC source, explicitly initialize it, then start or stop a bounded acquisition.

sections.label: Device type
sections.description: Selection alone never loads, scans, or contacts a physical device.
Explicit device lifecycle actions.

buttons.label: Initialize device
buttons.description: Construct and initialize the selected device only after this click. Missing drivers are reported safely.

buttons.label: Device Setup…
buttons.description: Open the selected device's native configuration card. Hardware settings remain locked while acquisition runs.

buttons.label: Start
buttons.description: Start the initialized device FIFO or encoded simulator stream through AcquisitionPipeline.

buttons.label: Stop
buttons.description: Request a safe stop, interrupt an active FIFO, and flush pipeline state.

sections.label: Time limit (s)
sections.description: Wall-clock stop condition. Set zero to disable it; retain a positive photon limit.

sections.label: Photon limit
sections.description: Decoded-photon stop condition. Set zero only when a positive time limit is configured.
Truthful initialization, streaming, stop, driver, and pipeline status.

sections.title: Routing and output
sections.description: Configure four legacy pipeline routing windows and an optional compatible-backend output folder.

sections.label: Routing channel 1
sections.description: Device routing channel for pipeline decay window 1.

sections.label: Routing channel 2
sections.description: Device routing channel for pipeline decay window 2.

sections.label: Routing channel 3
sections.description: Device routing channel for pipeline decay window 3.

sections.label: Routing channel 4
sections.description: Device routing channel for pipeline decay window 4.

sections.label: Output folder
sections.description: Optional path passed only to compatible simulation or BrickMic backends; this UI never claims every device writes raw files.
Choose an output path or save/load portable acquisition settings.

buttons.label: Browse output
buttons.description: Open a native folder chooser without creating or writing to the folder.

buttons.label: Save settings
buttons.description: Save device selection, limits, routing, output, result visibility, and simulator JSON to a chosen JSON file.

buttons.label: Load settings
buttons.description: Load and validate a JSON configuration without automatically contacting hardware.

sections.title: Simulator configuration
sections.description: Basic controls and a complete validated simulator dictionary for the encoded simulation path.

sections.label: Peak brightness
sections.description: Simulator brightness used to build encoded records; never a hardware detector setting.

sections.label: Deterministic seed
sections.description: Simulator random seed for reproducible encoded records.
Open a complete JSON editor for all simulator parameters, or the known demo stream.

buttons.label: Load example
buttons.description: Simulate a 20 s two-species stream with known lifetimes (3.4 ns and 1.1 ns), register it as a dataset and open the Acquisition fit window, whose decay, correlation, MCS and macro-time pages fill while it streams. The first time it simulates the stream; later it reuses the file.

buttons.label: Advanced simulation parameters
buttons.description: Edit the full actual simulator parameter dictionary; Apply validates it by constructing the simulator engine.

sections.title: Result visibility
sections.description: Show the live plot tabs in this native window.

sections.label: Decay plot
sections.description: Show the live decay plot tab.

sections.label: Correlation plot
sections.description: Show the live correlation plot tab.

sections.label: Count-rate plot
sections.description: Show the live count-rate plot tab.

sections.label: Macrotime plot
sections.description: Show the live macrotime plot tab.

sections.label: MCS plot
sections.description: Show the live MCS trace tab.
Clear result data or restore native defaults.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Clear displayed pipeline results without changing device selection.

buttons.label: Reset
buttons.description: Restore native defaults without constructing or contacting a device.

sections.title: Pipeline results
sections.description: Result tabs contain values calculated by AcquisitionPipeline from actual device FIFO or simulator records.
Live decay, correlation, count-rate, MCS and macrotime plots with their own controls, drawn from pipeline snapshots.
